description: Publish a SyncPen document to a connected CMS (WordPress, Ghost, or Sanity). Auto-selects the connection when only one is active for the target; otherwise pass connectionId.

connectionId.description: Optional: explicit CMS connection ID. Omit to auto-select the single active connection for the target.

documentId.description: The ID of the document to publish

status.description: Optional: post status. WordPress: 'draft' or 'publish'. Ghost/Sanity: 'draft' or 'published'. Defaults to published.

title.description: Optional: override the post title (defaults to the document's first heading, then its title).

name: syncpen_publish
